full_text:
Bellona is a Krono-Titan resembling a fierce lion adorned with the armor of an ancient Roman gladiator. The defensive Bellona Titans are also related to the offensive Hoplite Titans.

History

Bellona Titans were favorites of many Seekers in ancient Rome due to the defensive manner in which the Titans fought in combat.

Abilities

Bellona Titans are primarily defensive Titans who wear armor and who bear a large shield to protect themselves or other Titans behind their lines. Bellona Titans also wield a small sword, but are less skilled in offensive combat.

Trivia

• Bellona's name comes from that of the Roman goddess of war, Bellona, which is derived from the Latin word bellum, meaning "war." Bellona's name and appearance may also be a play on the Finnish jellona, a humorous word for "lion."

'''Bellona''' is a [[Krono-Titan]] resembling a fierce lion adorned with the armor of an ancient Roman gladiator. The defensive Bellona [[Titans]] are also related to the offensive [[Hoplite]] Titans.

== History ==
Bellona Titans were favorites of many Seekers in ancient Rome due to the defensive manner in which the Titans fought in combat.

== Abilities ==
Bellona Titans are primarily defensive Titans who wear armor and who bear a large shield to protect themselves or other Titans behind their lines. Bellona Titans also wield a small sword, but are less skilled in offensive combat.
